visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses and a black baseball cap stands in a semi-outdoor area, holding a large plastic cup of bubble tea with a red Mixue logo. He looks directly at the camera and speaks. (2) The scene shifts to a retail counter with a red surface; staff members wearing black t-shirts and blue nitrile gloves are visible. An orange plastic pumpkin bucket sits on the counter holding paper receipts. (3) A close-up shows a digital ordering kiosk with a touchscreen. A finger scrolls through menu items including 'Fresh Lemonade' and 'Ice Cream'. (4) A hand holds a smartphone near an Ingenico payment terminal to complete a contactless transaction. The screen shows a price of $17.30. (5) Back at the counter, a staff member in a black cap and glasses prepares a drink. Another staff member is seen using a soft-serve machine to swirl white ice cream onto a red-sleeved cone. (6) The main character is seen in various clips tasting the milk tea, peach tea, and lemonade. He shows close-up views of the cup's contents, revealing black pearls, white pearls, and red beans. (7) A woman with long hair is partially visible sitting at a yellow table, drinking from a straw and eating ice cream with a wooden spoon. (8) The video concludes with a wide shot of the 'MIXUE' storefront, featuring bright red signage and a white snowman mascot logo above the counter.
